event_description: Bellbrook is laid out and gazetted as a town. Under NSW land law of that era, road reservations in gazetted town layouts vested in the Crown by default, including - on the evidence available - Oreen Street and the laneway running behind the Main Street residential lots.

A tennis court is documented as existing between Oreen Street and the laneway, per the Bellbrook Historical Society's historical walk record - confirming both features were physically present and functionally referenced within eight years of gazettal.

Kempsey Shire Council adopts its Crown Land Plan of Management. It identifies Bellbrook's two named Crown reserves (Reserve 1036268, School of Arts; Reserve 78580, Memorial Park) but does not identify the laneway parcel or an Oreen Street parcel.

Crown Lands publishes the Administration of Crown Roads Policy IND-O-250 v2.0, establishing a discretionary transfer mechanism for Crown roads a council is already maintaining, and pre-emptively excluding road condition and financial implications as valid grounds for a council to refuse a transfer.
Kempsey Shire Council's Weekly Works Update records roadside slashing and vegetation control on Bellbrook Streets as completed works.

Kempsey Shire Council's Operational Plan 2025/26 commits $40.4 million to roads and bridges maintenance shire-wide, with active named capital works orders for Bellbrook roads, and no Crown road exclusion stated anywhere in the document.
Evidence Register frozen at 51 entries (39 originally self-classified Verified, 12 Unverified) by operator instruction, under the operator's then-current framework.

Analysis Register, Lattice Atlas, Temporal Projection Integrity Engine, Enforcement Notice, press release, and four advocacy/action documents (formal notice to Council, MP letter, GIPA application, recipient guide, verification card) completed and frozen the same day.

Case ingested into this repository as DFAPTI-BB-LW-2026-00001, translating the operator's earlier ER-/AR- framework into this repository's current schema. Whether the four action documents (formal notice, MP letter, GIPA application) had actually been sent as of the original 2026-07-18 freeze is unconfirmed as at ingestion - see CTR-0002.
